title: Anniversary Service-Level Review — Customer Care Desk Reference for Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
Every Ship-To Fulfillment Account is reviewed once for each anniversary of its opening date, and the anniversary review settles the service level the ship-to holds from the review on.

### When the review is due and which anniversary it covers

The review falls due on the anniversary and is recorded on the anniversary or, where it was not recorded that day, on the first later day the ship-to is handled; the review date is the day the review is recorded, and the review is for the most recent anniversary on or before the review date that has no review dated on or after it.

*Hypothetical:* a ship-to opened on 10 March reaches an anniversary on 10 March. If no review is recorded that day and the ship-to is next handled on 2 April, the review is recorded on 2 April, its review date is 2 April, and it is the review for the 10 March anniversary, provided no review is dated on or after 10 March.

### What the review settles

The review settles the level the ship-to holds from the review date: either the level it already holds or the level one place below it.

### Recording the review: `record_anniversary_review_a2ef3cef`

**Capability.** The tool records the anniversary service-level review of one Ship-To Fulfillment Account. It sets the service level the delivery location holds from today to the level supplied and stamps today's date as the location's most recent review date; nothing else on the location, its orders or its returns changes. Once stored, the ship-to lookup shows the new service level and review date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_anniversary_review_a2ef3cef` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ship_to_id` | the internal identifier of the ship-to (delivery location) being reviewed, as returned by the ship-to account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the service level the location holds once the review is recorded | exactly one of: Corbett Parcel Ship-To; Corbett Standard Ship-To; Corbett Priority Ship-To; Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To; Corbett Premier Route Ship-To; Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To |

The level is spelled exactly as listed: Corbett Parcel Ship-To for the parcel level, Corbett Standard Ship-To for the standard level, Corbett Priority Ship-To for the priority level, Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To for the route delivery level, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To for the premier route level and Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To for the dedicated delivery level.

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is the word recorded when the review was stored; `ship_to_id` is the location reviewed; `variant_name` is the service level now held, spelled as supplied; `last_review_date` is the review date stamped, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

*Illustration of the receipt shape (placeholder values):* status recorded, the reviewed ship-to's identifier, the level supplied, and the date of the call as the review date.
